generation_prompt.prompt: Create a cinematic {{size}} brand social media post for {{brand_name}}. Style: full-background photo hero with elegant text overlay. If a HERO asset is in the reference sheet, use it as the full-bleed background image. Apply a semi-transparent dark gradient overlay across the bottom third of the image so text remains legible. Place the brand logo at the top. Overlay headline text in {{color_palette.text}} with clean elegant typography. CTA button at the bottom.
generation_prompt.important_instruction: Hero photo fills the entire canvas edge-to-edge — do not add borders or frames around it. BRAND LOGO top-center, small and clean, on top of the photo. Gradient overlay covers bottom 30% for text legibility. Headline text large and cinematic in {{color_palette.text}}. CTA styled as a button with {{color_palette.primary}} background. Do NOT tile or repeat the reference image.
